main_text.p: Stabant Romani in armis, & vim faciebant. Igitur nono Aprilis, feria sexta, elegerunt Vrbanum se-xtum,qui coronatus fuit 18 eiusdem mensis, in die Paschæ. Tantum ille. Sub hac Pontifice, novum genus vel secta mirabilem quorundam daemoniacorum tam virorum quàm mulierum, praeter omnem verecundiam chorizantium, Petrus Pramonstratensis fuisse describit. Et anno Domini 1375 ex Aquisgrano in Hannoniam, atque inde in Franciam venisse demonstrat, quòd papæ Gregorij ac suorum Cardinalium commigrationem Romam praediuina-[?] re poterat. His videbatur, quòd in sanguinis flumine saltarent: quamuis astantes nihil tale viderint. Vulgus interpretabatur, quòd populus ille male baptizatus esset à presbyteris tenentibus meretri-ces. Propterea (inquit) proposuerat insurgere in clerum, eos occidendo, & bona eorum diripiendo: nisi Deus de remedio providisset per con-iurationes quasdam, &c. De hac chorizatione sit rhythmus,
Oritur in seculo novâ quadam secta, &c.
main_text.head: 143. VRBANVS sextus.
main_text.p: VRbanus sextus, patria Neapolitanus, Bartho-lomæus antea nuncupatus, archiepiscopus Ba-rensis, extra Cardinalitij senatus[?] ordinem & ab-sens,

page.notes: The scan is faded and the right edge is damaged; the words at the line ends are readable but the hyphens are faint. "praediuina-" and the hyphen after "meretri-" and "ab-" are uncertain. "senatus" is read from a long s printed as f ("fenatus"). The word "propofuerat" is printed with a long s and is given as "proposuerat". The last word of the page, "sens,", is a fragment continued on the next page. Verb "uidebatur" and similar words were changed from u to v as the rules require, and long s was rendered as plain s throughout.
